## History

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) Shirley considered giving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), a woman known for her harsh nature. However, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) ultimately disliked Mrs. Blewett's reputation and decided not to place [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with her family, where Flora Jane's mother would have put [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to work.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI.
